title: Air Fryer Crunchy Vego Ravioli
subtitle: with Charred Capsicum Salad
description: Craving a dinner that’s delightfully delish and easy to get on the table? We’re on a mission to make cooking more fun, extra yum and even simpler – this recipe, packed with quality fresh ingredients, is all that and more. Get cooking!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Preheat the air fryer to 200C (see Don't have an air fryer?). Cut the capsicum into thin wedges. Crush or finely chop the garlic.
Air-fry capsicum: Generously spray the capsicum with olive oil and put in the air-fryer basket. Air-fry the capsicum for 6-8 mins until tender and lightly charred. Remove from the air fryer.

Make tomato sauce: While the capsicum is cooking, heat 1 tsp olive oil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Cook the garlic, stirring, for 1 min or until golden and fragrant. Add the tomato puree, Italian seasoning and 1 tsp sugar and cook, stirring, for 5 mins to develop the flavour. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.

Air-fry ravioli: Spray or brush both sides of the ravioli with olive oil and put in the air-fryer basket, in batches if necessary (see Cooking tip). Air-fry the ravioli, shaking the basket halfway, for 10 mins or until golden and cooked through.

Serve up: Meanwhile, combine 2 tsp olive oil and 1½ tsp balsamic vinegar in a large bowl. Season with salt and pepper. Add the capsicum, spinach and sunflower seeds and toss to coat. Divide the ravioli and salad among plates and serve with the tomato sauce for dipping. Enjoy!

Don't have an air fryer?: No worries, you can grill the capsicum and cook the ravioli in a frypan. Heat 2 tbs olive oil in a frypan over medium heat. Cook the ravioli for 3-4 mins each side until golden and cooked through.
